# openvswitch / ofctl_parse_target

openvswitch's own fuzz target `ofctl_parse_target` ([source](source/ofctl_parse_target.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ovs (openvswitch/ovs at 1d415764).

parse_ofp_flow_mod_str then ofputil_encode_flow_mod for the first usable protocol; encoded message deleted unchecked.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ovs at commit 1d415764.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- the protocol chosen from usable_protocols is a single bit (is_pow2); trivially true by construction since protocol = 1u << i ([line 33](source/ofctl_parse_target.c#L33)): assert(); not confirmed in the binary.
